audit.whatIsWrong: Rated 'Even matchup — 5.5/10' while the win rate is 66.67% and the page's own whys give Karma levels 2 through 5 and the first item.
audit.why: Karma pokes at 950 against a 430-range Hammer Shock and a 475-range Heroic Charge. Until Poppy has resists and HP she cannot answer the chip.
audit.corrected: diffRating 3.5/10, carryRating 5/10, both difficulty lines reworded to favoured.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Poppy levels 3, 4-5 and first item and Karma level 6, while the whys on those exact rows say 'you out-range her', 'your bullying peak', 'you re-snowball' and 'Even window' for level 6.
audit.why: Poppy has no ranged answer before items; level 6 is the one genuinely contested stage because Keeper's Verdict plus a wall pin can flip a trade under tower.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 to Karma and row 4 to Skill, in matched pairs across both layers, ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings claim Steadfast Presence is 'damage reduction' that 'softens one Q'. Riot's text says it passively grants Armor and Magic Resist (increasing at low health) and, when activated, grants Move Speed and stops enemy dashes — there is no flat damage reduction. Separately, Keeper's Verdict is a channel and it was never stated that Karma's root cancels it.
audit.why: Describing W as a damage-reduction button tells the player to time poke around it, when the real effect is resists plus a speed-up that helps her walk through the poke — and the actionable interaction (Focused Resolve cancels her ult channel) was missing entirely.
audit.corrected: whys[2], early and wants.foe[1] now state resists and move speed; dosFull[2].d states that Focused Resolve's root cancels the Keeper's Verdict channel. Heroic Charge's 475 range and 14/13/12/11/10s cooldown added.

edits.before: Layered Q chip refunds your Mantra through Gathering Fire while Poppy, with no dash, still cannot reach you to trade back.
edits.after: Layered Q chip refunds Mantra through Gathering Fire, and Heroic Charge is only 475 range — she still cannot reach you to trade.

edits.before: You out-range her last-hits and her W only softens one Q via flat damage reduction; she has no way to close before her E charge.
edits.after: You out-range her last-hits at 950 against a 430 Hammer Shock, and Steadfast Presence gives resists and speed but no way to close.

edits.before: Pop Steadfast Presence (W) damage reduction to tank a Q and block any dash as she closes the gap on foot
edits.after: Pop Steadfast Presence for the move speed and low-health resists so she can walk through your poke and close the gap

edits.before: Poppy has no dash and no way to close the gap before her E charge, so open with RQ Soulflare and keep stacking Q poke — every ability and basic attack that hits her refunds your Mantra via Gathering Fire for the next rotation. The one thing to respect is her E (Heroic Charge): she shoulder-rushes you, and if your back is to a wall it pins you for a stun, so fight in open lane and never hug the side wall. Her W (Steadfast Presence) damage reduction can soften one Q and will block a dash, but it does nothing to stop you out-ranging her last-hits from max Q distance.
edits.after: Poppy has to walk at you until Heroic Charge is up, so open with RQ Soulflare and keep stacking Q poke — every ability and basic attack that hits her refunds your Mantra via Gathering Fire for the next rotation. The one to respect is her E (475 range, 14/13/12/11/10s): she shoulder-rushes you, and if your back is to a wall it pins you for a stun, so fight in open lane and never hug the side wall. Her W (Steadfast Presence) gives resists and move speed and stops dashes, but nothing in it stops you out-ranging her last-hits from max Q distance.

edits.before: Poppy burns Steadfast Presence on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is a channel — Focused Resolve's root cancels it outright.

edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 3.5/10, Poppy carry threat 5/10.

notes: Steadfast Presence was described as flat damage reduction in three places; Riot's text has no damage reduction, only resists (scaling with her missing health), move speed and dash-stopping. Corrected. I left row 6 as Poppy even though the packet says Skill, because both the whys and the late text say she out-scales the raw 1v1 at two items and I would not invent a power shift to match a 12-game sample. The 66.67% win rate is also only 12 games, so the difficulty numbers are Medium confidence.
